literal_meaning: অবস্থা সম্পর্কে জ্ঞাত বা সচেতন (ওয়াকিব: জ্ঞাত; হাল: অবস্থা)
figurative_meaning_en: Aware of the situation; fully knowledgeable about the circumstances
example_sentences_in_bangla: আমরা সবার ওয়াকিবহাল রাখবো এই বিষয়ে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is well aware of the political situation.
We will keep everyone informed about this matter.
history: This idiom is derived from Persian-Arabic roots and is used in Bengali literature, as exemplified in the works of writer Mujtaba Ali.
note: The term has Urdu-Persian influences common in Bengali literary language.
